explanation: Use the BST ordering to skip subtrees entirely below or above the inclusive interval. When a node lies inside the interval, traverse left, append it and traverse right to keep the results sorted.
timeComplexity: O(h+m), bounded by O(n), for m returned keys
spaceComplexity: O(h) recursion stack plus O(m) output
